question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aea3cd4bea47c6d4199575860a895f9cf7716f8f046735520229d9e59283e806.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: 1 small straight line is added in each images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13085364ace6ea33e54a854a2da8ee3af1a009df26b9e860caf6f63a24077bc6.png] 

Step II: 1 small straight line are removed from each images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/796d50f5d1a4209b3acb9793c98fd3b076732a9d6304db6403f2249b03917883.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd8d8e3c0896b4bd3c15c0a1141d699c31650acbc4cdbe1e8f2eac0b15391ec9.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
